# CampusBuzz

CampusBuzz is a fictional inter-college festival concept and mock event-pass prototype for a digital marketing project. It presents a student-focused, three-day festival at the fictional Neon Valley Institute in Karachi. Festival events, people, venues, prices, and pass availability are simulated; no real tickets are sold, no payments are processed, and demo passes are not valid for entry.

## Website

- [CampusBuzz homepage](https://campusbuzz-kappa.vercel.app/)
- [Festival teaser](https://campusbuzz-kappa.vercel.app/teaser.html)
- [Events](https://campusbuzz-kappa.vercel.app/events.html)
- [Passes](https://campusbuzz-kappa.vercel.app/passes.html)
- [Blog](https://campusbuzz-kappa.vercel.app/blog.html)

## Event categories

The festival categories are Music, Gaming, Tech, and Art. Events include live music, esports and arcade challenges, hackathons and robotics, startup pitches, and student art.
